contract: A follower copies the leader's offset, epoch, and bytes. An interrupted copy resumes from the last confirmed offset after reopen.
A divergent follower suffix is truncated to the first mismatch, then the leader bytes are copied.
A leader epoch older than one the follower already stores is fenced and does not change the follower log.
One call copies at most the requested record count and payload bytes.
limits: This is a local replica log, not a Kafka Fetch RPC and not a network replica.
High watermarks, min ISR, and replicated produce acknowledgments stay on KL11-19.
The journal format is the local PLREPL01 record, not an Apache record batch log.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
